svg.title: Explicit sequential coupling within one atmospheric time step
svg.desc: Step n: the fluxes F^n are computed from the post-adiabatic atmospheric state and the old surface boundary B^n. runtime_spectral_diabatic() adds the F^n tendencies to the atmosphere within the same step, while land_step() and sea_step() use F^n to update land, sea ice and ocean and build the new boundary B^(n+1). B^(n+1) is first used by the fluxes of step n+1.
